rank30_corollary: base rank 8 and representative twist rank at least 8 force packet rank at least 32
theorem: The three quadratic twists by -t, t-1, and -t(t-1) are pairwise Q(t)-isomorphic. If the base rank is r0 and one representative twist has rank r, the V4 packet has rank r0+3r over its rational genus-zero base.
truth_note: This is a rank-compression theorem, not yet a construction of a twist of rank 8 over Q(t).
